title: SynthFHIR
summary: A production-oriented pipeline that ingests Synthea FHIR JSON bundles, parses them into structured tables, and trains deep generative models to produce synthetic patient records with preserved clinical distributions and relational structure. It uses SDV's single-table (CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer) and sequential (PARSynthesizer) synthesizers, plus SDV metadata objects, as the core generation engine for its multi-table healthcare training pipeline.
evidence: src/synthesis/ctgan_trainer.py:99-107 builds CTGANSynthesizer/TVAESynthesizer/GaussianCopulaSynthesizer via sdv.single_table; par_trainer.py imports sdv.sequential.PARSynthesizer
